_meta.description: A timed two-drone mission for the phones' demo mode: the fleet on the ground, the plan, the start, the drones flying their lanes, an obstacle cut, a detection, a person-match alert that later gets a reasoning verdict and an upgrade, the operator's confirm on the laptop, a drone left HELD when the laptop's browser went away, LAND ALL and the landing. Every payload comes from the real ground code or from another fixture file; every id starts with demo-.

scenario.notes: Demo mode only. A phone replays steps in order on its own clock (at_ms from the start of the demo), each as if the ground had sent that Socket.IO event. It answers get_detection_profiles, get_ceiling_settings, get_reasoning_provider and get_manual_status from state, and get_fleet_status with the latest fleet_status and fleet_plan it replayed. It answers land_all, drone_command and manual_resume_search locally with the events in replies (drone_command and manual_resume_search with drone_id replaced by the commanded drone). held names the drone that hovers HELD with nobody controlling it, from from_ms until LAND ALL at until_ms, so Resume search can be tried. After the last step, or after a demo LAND ALL, landed_fleet_status is the fleet at rest, and a phone keeps sending the current fleet status. Every drone, alert and track id starts with demo-, so it can never be taken for a real one. In demo mode a phone never opens a network connection and never sends a command anywhere.
